column23: The end of white streetlights in Christiansted before driving to the eastern point of St. Croix.
Most western point. All rocks and a lot of foul sargassum!
The small cottage on the west end of the beach turned off its nights. When it was on, it was bright.
On top of berm because of high wall.
We started right here in the beginning at the coconut tree where the main area is on the beach. Near the post critter signs.
Light readings surrounded by tall grass.
A lot of vegetation. Very little open sand in this spot. Hilly at the bottom of the berm. Beach lettuce is here.

Wide open beach at this location (wider than all the other points). Flood lights from Candle Reef are visible. Hence the brightness in the LW reading. There are 2 white lights and 3 soft yellow luminares.
On the bottom of the berm.
On top of the berm (beach berm very tall and narrow).
LW is blocked by vegetation. White foam from waves are wide for SW readings. Cloud cover has increased.
Flat, open sand beach with view you can see the sky glow from Candle Reef Condos.
Gets a little narrower. Can see one light from Candle Reef.
Last point on the east side
